summary: Round 69 fixes — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. ALL 23 backend pytest tests PASS (3 NEW test_ai_round69.py + 20 carry-over). Live AI verification via /api/ai/chat confirms: (a) NO 'configura la provincia in impostazioni' phrase when mercati_lista is populated; (b) AI cites Milano + Lombardia deduced from mercati_lista 'Milano|Monza|Bergamo'; (c) response cites Confcommercio/FIVA, Confesercenti, Camera di Commercio, ASCO/Unione Commercianti Milano, Regione Lombardia with concrete convenzioni (RC ambulanti FIVA, voucher €2500, formazione SAB/HACCP gratuita per soci, sconti carburante Q8/IP); (d) '💡 Suggerimento extra:' present proactively. Frontend Carburante page: auto-cleanup CONFIRMED at runtime — seed contained 2 phantom future entries (today+3 €99, today+7 €88) plus 1 past €50; console emitted '[appStore] Rimossi 2 rifornimenti con data futura (cleanup automatico)' and the page totale shows only €50 (no €99/€88). 'Pulisci mese visualizzato' button (testID gas-clear-month) present below legend, tap triggers window.confirm with correct dynamic message 'Vuoi davvero cancellare TUTTI i 1 rifornimenti di Giugno 2026? Operazione irreversibile.' Round 68 protections preserved (future days dimmed, right-chevron disabled, holiday legend present). Fattura load-restoration logic (issue #1) verified by code review: home/index.tsx lines 464-495 correctly derives pagamentoMode from key suffixes (base→fattura, __libera→contanti, both→misto) — fix is logically sound and isolated. ONE MINOR NON-BLOCKING ISSUE FOUND: appStore.loadFromStorage future-cleanup mutates in-memory state but does NOT include the cleanup in the wasMigrated persistence check (line 985-988), so localStorage retains stale future entries until the next saveToStorage call. Effect: UI is correct (no phantoms shown), but if user closes app before next mutation, the disk-cleanup repeats on every cold start. Cosmetic — log line confirms cleanup ran correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After loadFromStorage removes future-dated carburante entries from `parsed.storicoCarburante` (lines 857-872) and `set(parsed)`, the wasMigrated check at lines 985-988 does NOT include the removal flag, so JSON.stringify is NOT written back to localStorage immediately. In-memory state is correct (UI shows no phantoms) but disk still has them until next saveToStorage(). Fix: include `(typeof console !== 'undefined' && /* future-removed flag */ true)` — easiest is to track `removed > 0` in a let and add to wasMigrated condition. Reference: /app/frontend/src/store/appStore.ts:985.

action_items: MINOR: In /app/frontend/src/store/appStore.ts:857-872, track `let futureRemoved = removed > 0;` and include it in the `wasMigrated` boolean at line 985 so the cleanup is persisted on first load. rca_of_issue:
Issue 1 (Fattura saving) RCA: Data was correctly written to storicoGiornate.dettaglio_fornitori with key suffix conventions (nomeBase=fattura, nomeBase__libera=contanti), but on re-load the UI never reconstructed pagamentoMode, defaulting all fornitori to 'contanti' — user perceived 'la fattura non si salva'. Fix: home/index.tsx:464-495 now iterates dettaglio_fornitori entries, classifies by suffix, aggregates per-fornitore flags, and sets the toggle state accordingly.

Issue 2 (Phantom carburante) RCA: Round 68 fixed the tap on future days, but legacy localStorage still contained phantom future entries from before that fix. Round 69 added defense-in-depth: (a) loadFromStorage filters future entries on every cold start; (b) addCarburante rejects future dates silently; (c) NEW clearCarburanteInRange + UI button so the user can wipe a specific month manually. Runtime confirmed: 2 phantom future entries removed, only past €50 entry remained.

Issue 3 (Province deduction) RCA: Previous AI prompt allowed asking user to 'configura la provincia in impostazioni'. Fix: backend now (a) parses mercati_lista from frontend, (b) geocodes up to 8 cities, (c) injects MERCATO_INFO with regioni_coperte/province_coperte into context, (d) system prompt has INVIOLABLE rule forbidding the 'configura provincia' phrase. Verified by pytest regex + live AI test.

Issue 4 (Accurate news) RCA: Previous prompt produced vague URL-only suggestions. New prompt enumerates 6 categories (FIVA-Confcommercio, ANVA-Confesercenti, Camera di Commercio, Regione, ASCO/Unione Commercianti, INPS/Agenzia Entrate) with CONCRETE convenzioni per category, and mandates a '💡 Suggerimento extra:' proactive section. Verified by live AI response containing all required institutions + the suggerimento line.
